scripts.gateway: cd services/gateway && uv run python -m app --reload
scripts.gateway:mock: cd services/gateway && uv run python -m app --mock --reload
scripts.reset: uv run --no-project python -c "import urllib.request as u; print(u.urlopen(u.Request('http://localhost:8000/api/director/reset', method='POST')).read().decode())"
scripts.loadtest: uv run --no-project --with httpx --with websockets python infra/loadtest_votes.py --n 50
